description: Utility functions for filesystem operations, string manipulation, JSON parsing, path resolution, and environment configuration, used across the project.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path, including parent directories if necessary.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: clampNumber
methods.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: clampInt
methods.description: Floors a number and clamps it between min and max.

methods.name: escapeRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: safeParseJson
methods.description: Parses JSON string safely, returning null on error.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object that isn't an array.

methods.name: normalizeE164
methods.description: Normalizes phone numbers to E.164 format.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: sliceUtf16Safe
methods.description: Slices a string safely considering UTF-16 surrogate pairs.

methods.name: truncateUtf16Safe
methods.description: Truncates a string safely considering UTF-16 surrogate pairs.

methods.name: resolveUserPath
methods.description: Resolves a user path, expanding home directory references.

methods.name: resolveConfigDir
methods.description: Resolves the configuration directory path based on environment variables.

methods.name: shortenHomePath
methods.description: Replaces home directory path with a shortcut in a given path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of home directory path with a shortcut in a string.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Displays a path with home directory shortened.

methods.name: displayString
methods.description: Displays a string with home directory shortened.
